strings: Feeling a deep bond with the nursery, m_c has chosen to serve the Clan as a queen's apprentice. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} excited to begin {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nurturing journey.

Rather than the thrill of the hunt or the heat of battle, m_c is drawn to the gentle rhythm of the nursery. With r_c0 by {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} side, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} ready to learn the ways of the queens.
Having always felt a connection to the kits, m_c is inspired by r_c0's dedication in the nursery. Eager to follow in {PRONOUN/r_c0/poss} pawsteps, m_c is taken under r_c0's nurturing wing.

While m_c admires the bravery of warriors and the wisdom of elders, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} heart lies with the young ones in the nursery. Under r_c0's guidance, m_c embarks on the path to become a devoted carer.
Despite some questioning looks, m_c is firm in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} resolve to be under r_c0's tutelage: the future of the Clan lies in the paws of the kits, and that's where m_c wants to be.
It's a dream come true for m_c: to be under r_c0's guidance and be a queen's apprentice. For m_c, the nursery is where the heart of the Clan beats strongest.
Every Clan's strength lies in its young, and m_c wishes to be at the forefront of that, learning and growing as a queen's apprentice with r_c0 to guide the way.
With a heart full of compassion, m_c sees the importance of the next generation and decides to dedicate {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life to the well-being of the Clan's kits.
m_c believes that being a queen's apprentice is {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} true calling; m_c hopes to make a lasting impact in the heart of the nursery.
Recognizing m_c's innate ability to care and nurture, r_c0 feels it's only natural to train m_c as the next queen's apprentice.
Captivated by the tales and warmth of the nursery, m_c has been shadowing r_c0, showing an interest in becoming a queen's apprentice. r_c0 welcomes the enthusiastic new pupil.
